name: Open WebUI
description: Feature-rich ChatGPT-like web interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible LLMs, designed to run entirely offline.

env.label: Ollama Base URL
env.description: URL of the Ollama API server

env.label: OpenAI API Key
env.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Leave empty if only using Ollama.

env.label: OpenAI API Base URL
env.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API. Change for third-party providers.

env.label: Anthropic API Key
env.description: API key for Anthropic Claude models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Google Gemini API Key
env.description: API key for Google Gemini models; can also be configured in the Web UI

env.label: Enable Signup
env.description: Allow new users to register accounts

env.label: Default User Role
env.description: Default role assigned to new users upon registration

env.label: Enable Authentication
env.description: Enable or disable authentication. Disable only for local-only setups.
